settings.intro:
⚙️ *Settings*

Bot notifications in Telegram: *{notif_state}*
(bookings, cancellations, gym messages)

Choose an action:

common.welcome:
👋 Hello, {name}!

I'm the CrossFit Hub bot — workouts and schedule.

📝 Up to *{max_per_day}* active bookings per calendar day (set by your gym admin).
📅 Schedule shows the next 7 days; today's past sessions are hidden.

Choose an action below:
common.help:
ℹ️ *CrossFit Hub Bot Help*

Use /start to begin.
common.help_athlete:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub*

📅 *Booking*
• «Sign Up for a Workout» → pick a day within the next 7 days
• Today's list hides workouts that already started
• You cannot book a workout in the past

📋 *My Bookings*
• View and cancel active bookings

⚙️ *Settings*
• Interface language
• Turn bot notifications on/off

📸 *Schedule image*
• On the day picker — weekly image (if admin uploaded it)

📝 *Limits*
• At most *{max_per_day}* active bookings per *calendar day* (admin sets this in the web panel)
• Each workout has its own capacity

Restart: /start
common.help_trainer:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub (Trainer)*

📅 *Schedule Overview*
• Browse workouts for the next 7 days
• Tap your workout → «Manage Participants»
• Remove an athlete from your workout

🏋️ *My Workouts*
• Your assigned workouts for the week
• Remove athlete: tap «❌ Remove [name]»

📋 *Free Slots*
• Unassigned workouts for the next 7 days
• Tap «Assign Myself» to take a slot

Restart: /start
common.help_admin:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub (Admin)*

👑 *Admin Panel (bot)*
• View schedule: today / tomorrow / week
• Assign trainer to a workout
• Delete workout (athletes get notified)
• Upload schedule image (📸)

🌐 *Web Interface*
• Create and edit workouts
• Bulk create from template
• Manage users and roles
• Edit schedule template

🏋️ *Trainer Panel (bot)*
• Schedule overview, manage your workouts
• Self-assign to free slots

Restart: /start
